issues.display_title: Issue #467: Profile Published Folder Bookmarks API
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 16/07/26

✅ Implementation: Profile Published Folder Bookmarks API

Example API

Endpoint: GET /bookmark/published/profile/:username
Description: Retrieves paginated published bookmark folders for a profile user. This endpoint powers the published bookmark folder list in profile.

Example cURL Request

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/profile/<username>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "role: viewer" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=9"

Request Parameters

  • username (string, required): Profile username.
  • page (int, optional): Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
  • limit (int, optional): Number of folders per page. Defaults to 9.

Headers

  • Authorization (string, required): Bearer token.
  • role (string, required): Allowed values are viewer, user, and my-user.
  • ec (string, optional): Set true for encrypted response. Defaults to plain JSON behavior.

Role Rules

  • viewer: can list public published bookmark folders for a profile.
  • user: can list another user's public published bookmark folders, with blocked/deactive checks.
  • my-user: can list only the authenticated user's own profile. If :username belongs to another user, returns 403.
  • Other roles return 401 Unauthorized.

Data Source

This endpoint reads from:

public.views_published_folders

It also joins:

public.folder_bookmark

The join is used to make published_at reliable:

COALESCE(v.published_at, fb.published_at, fb.updated_at, fb.created_at) AS published_at

Success Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List Published Folder Bookmark Profile",
    "folders": [
      {
        "slug": "ob97a4a99d3-2026040810361400",
        "name": "CN Tower",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
        "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
        "total_bookmark": 12
      }
    ],
    "total": 24,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 9
  }
}

Empty Response

If the profile exists but has no published folders, the endpoint returns an empty list.

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List Published Folder Bookmark Profile",
    "folders": [],
    "total": 0,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 9
  }
}

User Not Found Response

{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "status": "Conflict",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "User Not Found"
    }
  }
}

Forbidden Response

Returned when role: my-user is used for another user's profile, or when a user has blocked the target profile.

{
  "statusCode": 403,
  "data": {
    "status": "Forbidden",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "This is not your profile"
    }
  }
}

Unauthorized Response

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "status": "Unauthorized",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Unauthorized"
    }
  }
}

Summary

Implemented a profile API that lists published bookmark folders for a target user. The endpoint uses the existing published folder view and returns a minimal folder response for the profile bookmark tab.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/profile/:username?page=1&limit=9

Files Changed

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListPublishedFolderBookmarkProfile.go
  • src/Controllers/V1/BookmarksControllers.go
  • src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes.go
  • src/Models/FolderBookmarkModel.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/List Published Folder Bookmark Profile.yml

Response Fields

Each folder item returns:

  • slug
  • name
  • thumbnail
  • published_at
  • total_bookmark

No created_at field is returned.

Role Handling

Supported roles:

  • viewer
  • user
  • my-user

Unsupported roles return 401 Unauthorized.

For viewer, the API returns published public folder data from views_published_folders.

For user, the API validates authenticated user data, rejects a blocked target profile, and filters deactive target users.

For my-user, the API requires the target user id to match c.Locals("userId"). This prevents role: my-user from reading another username's profile and avoids unnecessary blocked/deactive checks for the user's own profile.

Query

The endpoint uses views_published_folders and joins folder_bookmark to make published_at reliable:

SELECT
  v.slug,
  v.name,
  v.thumbnail,
  COALESCE(v.published_at, fb.published_at, fb.updated_at, fb.created_at) AS published_at,
  v.total_bookmark
FROM views_published_folders AS v
LEFT JOIN folder_bookmark AS fb ON fb.slug = v.slug
WHERE v.owner_username = ?
ORDER BY COALESCE(v.published_at, fb.published_at, fb.updated_at, fb.created_at) DESC
LIMIT ?
OFFSET ?

Pagination

Defaults:

  • page = 1
  • limit = 9

Response includes:

  • total
  • page
  • limit

API Collection

Added:

api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/List Published Folder Bookmark Profile.yml

Includes:

  • default request
  • 200 response example
  • 409 User Not Found response example

Verification

Ran:

go test ./...

Result: pass.

Goal

Add an API for the profile bookmark tab that lists bookmark folders already published by a target user.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/profile/:username?page=1&limit=9

Required Folder Data

Each folder item should contain:

  • slug
  • name
  • thumbnail
  • published_at
  • total_bookmark

Do not return created_at.

Behavior

  • Support roles viewer, user, and my-user.
  • Reject other roles with 401 Unauthorized.
  • For viewer, return only public published folder data from views_published_folders.
  • For user, validate user data, reject blocked target profile, and filter deactive profile users.
  • For my-user, only allow the authenticated user's own profile by comparing the target user.
  • For my-user, skip extra blocked/deactive filtering intended for other profiles.
  • Return pagination metadata: total, page, and limit.
  • Support ec=true encrypted response.

Response Example

        "name": "CN Tower",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
        "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
        "total_bookmark": 12
      }
    ],
    "total": 24,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 9
  }
}

Files

  • src/Controllers/V1/BookmarksControllers.go

Implementation Notes

  • Use existing views_published_folders; do not create a new view.
  • Query should filter by owner_username = :username.
  • Join folder_bookmark by slug to make published_at reliable.
  • Select COALESCE(v.published_at, fb.published_at, fb.updated_at, fb.created_at) AS published_at.
  • Order by the same COALESCE(...) DESC expression.
  • Register route before /bookmark/published/:slug.

issues.display_title: Issue #468: Published Folder Bookmark Detail API
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 16/07/26

✅ Implementation: Published Folder Bookmark Header API

Example API

Endpoint: GET /bookmark/published/:slug
Description: Retrieves one published bookmark folder by exact slug. This endpoint is used for the folder detail/header data, so the frontend can refresh /bookmark/published/:slug without relying on search results.

Example cURL Request

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false"

Request Parameters

  • slug (string, required): Published folder bookmark slug.

Visibility Rules

  • Role viewer can access public published folder detail.
  • Role user can access public published folder detail.
  • Other roles return 401 Unauthorized.
  • All roles exclude deactivated owners.
  • Role user also excludes blocked owners.

Data Source

This endpoint reads from:

public.views_published_folders

Required view columns:

  • id
  • slug
  • name
  • description
  • location
  • location_name
  • category_name
  • published_at
  • total_bookmark
  • thumbnail
  • owner_username
  • owner_fullname
  • owner_avatar
  • owner_encrypt

It also checks:

public.broadcast

The broadcast check is used to set potd.

Success Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark",
    "bookmark": {
      "slug": "cn-tower",
      "name": "CN Tower",
      "description": "Published folder description",
      "location": {
        "lat": 43.6426,
        "lng": -79.3871
      },
      "location_name": "Toronto",
      "category_name": "Leisure",
      "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
      "potd": false,
      "total_bookmark": {
        "counter_bookmak": 12
      },
      "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
      "user": {
        "username": "sunnybreeze",
        "fullname": "Sunny Breeze",
        "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "encrypt": "abcd123"
      }
    }
  }
}

Not Found Response

If the folder slug does not exist or is hidden by deactivated/blocked owner filtering:

{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "status": "Conflict",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Folder Not Found"
    }
  }
}

Unauthorized Response

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "status": "Unauthorized",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Unauthorized"
    }
  }
}

FE Usage Example

Use this endpoint for folder detail/header data:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false"

Then load posts from:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>/posts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Summary

Implemented a dedicated published folder detail endpoint so FE can load or refresh a folder detail page directly by slug. This replaces the previous dependency on /search/folder-bookmark/published search results for detail data.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/:slug

Files Changed

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/PublishedFolderBookmark.go
  • src/Controllers/V1/BookmarksControllers.go
  • src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes.go
  • src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes_test.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/Published Folder Bookmark Header.yml

Implementation Details

Action

Created PublishedFolderBookmark in src/Action/V1/Bookmarks.

Behavior:

  • Reads slug from route params.
  • Supports role viewer and user.
  • Rejects unsupported roles with 401 Unauthorized.
  • Loads deactive users from Redis key:
    • <prefix>_deactive_users_ec
  • For role user, loads:
    • user data through UserFunctions.UserDatas
    • blocked users from <prefix>_blocked_users_ec_<encrypt>
  • Queries views_published_folders by exact slug.

Core query:

query := Config.DB.Table("views_published_folders").
    Select("id, slug, name, description, location, location_name, category_name, published_at, total_bookmark, thumbnail, owner_username, owner_fullname, owner_avatar, owner_encrypt").
    Where("slug = ?", slug)

Blocked/deactivated owner filter:

if len(notInEncrypt) > 0 {
    query = query.Where("owner_encrypt NOT IN (?)", notInEncrypt)
}

If the query does not find a visible folder, the endpoint returns:

409 Folder Not Found

Response Mapping

The response reuses Models.SearchFolderBookmark so the detail payload stays compatible with search result folder items.

Mapped fields:

  • user object from owner columns:
    • owner_username
    • owner_fullname
    • owner_avatar
    • owner_encrypt
  • total_bookmark object:
    • counter_bookmak
  • potd flag by checking broadcast.folder_id = folderBookmark.ID

The counter_bookmak typo is preserved for existing FE compatibility.

Controller

Added:

func PublishedFolderBookmark(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
    return BookmarksAction.PublishedFolderBookmark(c)
}

Route

Registered:

Bookmark.Get("/published/:slug", Controllers.PublishedFolderBookmark)

Final route:

GET /bookmark/published/:slug

API Collection

Added:

api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/Published Folder Bookmark Header.yml

The collection documents success and 409 Folder Not Found examples.

Response Shape

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark",
    "bookmark": {
      "slug": "cn-tower",
      "name": "CN Tower",
      "description": "Published folder description",
      "location": {
        "lat": 43.6426,
        "lng": -79.3871
      },
      "location_name": "Toronto",
      "category_name": "Leisure",
      "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
      "total_bookmark": {
        "counter_bookmak": 12
      },
      "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
      "user": {
        "username": "sunnybreeze",
        "fullname": "Sunny Breeze",
        "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "encrypt": "abcd123"
      },
      "potd": false
    }
  }
}

Verification

Red test first:

go test ./src/Routes/V1 -run TestRegisterBookmarksRoutesAddsPublishedDetailAndPostsRoutes -count=1

Expected failure before route update:

expected GET route /bookmark/published/:slug/posts to be registered

Final checks:

go test ./src/Routes/V1 -run TestRegisterBookmarksRoutesAddsPublishedDetailAndPostsRoutes -count=1
go test ./...

Result: pass.

Goal

Create a dedicated detail endpoint for a published bookmark folder so the frontend can open or refresh /bookmark/published/:slug without depending on search results.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/:slug

Requirements

  • Query published folder data by exact slug: views_published_folders.slug = ?.
  • Do not use search query behavior such as name ILIKE.
  • Keep role support for user and viewer.
  • Exclude deactivated owners for all roles.
  • For role user, also exclude blocked owners.
  • Return 409 Folder Not Found if the slug does not exist or is hidden by block/deactivated filters.
  • Return the same folder payload shape as the search published folder bookmark item, wrapped as a single bookmark object.
  • Include user, total_bookmark, and potd fields using the same mapping behavior as SearchPublishedFolderBookmark.
  • Support encrypted response when header ec: true.

Response Shape

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark",
    "bookmark": {
      "slug": "cn-tower",
      "name": "CN Tower",
      "description": "Published folder description",
      "location": {
        "lat": 43.6426,
        "lng": -79.3871
      },
      "location_name": "Toronto",
      "category_name": "Leisure",
      "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
      "total_bookmark": {
        "counter_bookmak": 12
      },
      "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
      "user": {
        "username": "sunnybreeze",
        "fullname": "Sunny Breeze",
        "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "encrypt": "abcd123"
      },
      "potd": false
    }
  }
}

Implementation Notes

  • Add handler in src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/PublishedFolderBookmark.go.
  • Add controller wrapper in src/Controllers/V1/BookmarksControllers.go.
  • Register route in src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes.go.
  • Add route test in src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes_test.go.
  • Add API collection example for the new detail endpoint.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug returns one folder detail by exact slug.
  • Refreshing a folder detail page works without using /search/folder-bookmark/published.
  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug no longer returns posts.
  • go test ./... passes.

issues.display_title: Issue #469: Published Folder Bookmark Posts API
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 16/07/26

✅ Implementation: Published Folder Bookmark Posts API

Example API

Endpoint: GET /bookmark/published/:slug/posts
Description: Retrieves paginated posts inside a published folder bookmark. Folder/header data comes from GET /bookmark/published/:slug.

Example cURL Request

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>/posts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Request Parameters

  • slug (string, required): Published folder bookmark slug.
  • page (int, optional): Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
  • limit (int, optional): Number of posts per page. Defaults to 10.

Visibility Rules

  • Role viewer can access public published folder posts.
  • Role user can access public published folder posts.
  • Other roles return 401 Unauthorized.
  • All roles exclude:
    • deactivated users
    • private/non-public posts
    • unpublished posts
    • video360 posts
  • Role user also excludes:
    • blocked users
    • blocked posts

Data Source

This endpoint reads from:

public.views_published_folder_posts

Required view columns:

  • folder_slug
  • bookmark_created_at
  • slug
  • username
  • avatar
  • description
  • thumbnail
  • post_type
  • potd
  • counter_view
  • counter_like
  • counter_comment
  • visibility
  • is_publish
  • encrypt

Success Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark Detail",
    "posts": [
      {
        "slug": "post-slug",
        "username": "sunnybreeze",
        "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "description": "Travel is not just about visiting new places.",
        "short_description": "Travel is not just about visiting new places.",
        "long_description": "",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
        "post_type": "panorama",
        "potd": false,
        "counter_view": 48,
        "counter_like": 3,
        "counter_comment": 21
      }
    ],
    "total_posts": 19,
    "total_views_all_posts": 328000,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10
  }
}

Empty Or Not Found Response

If no visible posts are available for the requester, the endpoint returns 409.

{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "status": "Conflict",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Folder Not Found"
    }
  }
}

Unauthorized Response

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "status": "Unauthorized",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Unauthorized"
    }
  }
}

FE Usage Example

Load folder detail/header first:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false"

Then load posts:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>/posts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Published Folder Bookmark Posts API Implementation

Summary

Moved the published folder post list contract to its own nested route. Folder detail and folder posts are now separate endpoints:

  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug for folder detail/header data.
  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug/posts for paginated posts in that folder.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/:slug/posts?page=1&limit=10

Files Changed

  • src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes.go
  • src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes_test.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/Published Folder Bookmark Detail.yml

Existing post list handler reused:

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/PublishedFolderBookmarkDetail.go

Implementation Details

Route

Registered the post list endpoint:

Bookmark.Get("/published/:slug/posts", Controllers.PublishedFolderBookmarkDetail)

The old route path was repurposed:

Bookmark.Get("/published/:slug", Controllers.PublishedFolderBookmark)

Final behavior:

  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug returns folder detail.
  • GET /bookmark/published/:slug/posts returns posts.

Action Reuse

The existing PublishedFolderBookmarkDetail handler remains the post list implementation.

It keeps the existing behavior:

  • Reads slug from route params.
  • Reads page and limit from query params.
  • Defaults:
    • page = 1
    • limit = 10
  • Supports role viewer and user.
  • Rejects unsupported roles with 401 Unauthorized.
  • Loads deactive users from Redis key:
    • <prefix>_deactive_users_ec
  • For role user, loads:
    • user data through UserFunctions.UserDatas
    • blocked users from <prefix>_blocked_users_ec_<encrypt>
    • blocked posts from <prefix>_blocked_post_ec_<encrypt>
  • Queries views_published_folder_posts.

Base query:

Config.DB.Table("views_published_folder_posts").
    Where("folder_slug = ?", folderSlug).
    Where("visibility = ?", "public").
    Where("is_publish = ?", true).
    Where("post_type != ?", "video360")

Additional filters:

if len(blockPost) != 0 {
    query.Where("slug NOT IN (?)", blockPost)
}

if len(notInEncrypt) != 0 {
    query.Where("encrypt NOT IN (?)", notInEncrypt)
}

Totals

The handler calculates:

  • total_posts using COUNT(*) from the filtered query before pagination.
  • total_views_all_posts using COALESCE(SUM(counter_view), 0) from the same filtered scope.

If total_posts == 0, it returns:

409 Folder Not Found

Post List

Posts are selected with:

Select("slug, username, avatar, description, thumbnail, post_type, potd, counter_view, counter_like, counter_comment").
    Order("bookmark_created_at DESC").
    Limit(limit).
    Offset(offset)

Description processing is preserved:

  • html.UnescapeString
  • PostFunctions.WrapText

API Collection

Updated:

api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Posts/Folder Bookmark/Published Folder Bookmark Detail.yml

The collection now points post-list examples to:

/bookmark/published/:slug/posts

Goal

Move the published folder post list to its own endpoint so folder detail and folder posts have separate API contracts.

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/:slug/posts

Requirements

  • Return paginated posts inside a published folder bookmark.
  • Query posts from views_published_folder_posts.
